standards.applies_because: Safety of personal care robots (mobile servant robot in the home)
Electrical safety of the ICT/electronics part (camera, compute, charger)
Household appliance safety if marketed as an appliance (general requirements)
Laser safety of the lidar / ToF emitters
Li-ion pack shipped inside the product
Wi-Fi / BLE radios and digital electronics (US)
Wi-Fi / BLE radios (EU), incl. the cybersecurity delegated act for connected devices

risks.risk: Pinch and crush points in wheels, arms and joints
risks.mitigation: Torque/current limiting, compliant covers, finger-safe gaps, force limits per ISO 13482

risks.risk: Falls down stairs or tips on thresholds and rugs
risks.mitigation: Cliff sensors (IR ToF) facing down, low centre of mass, max-slope limit in firmware

risks.risk: Battery thermal runaway in a closed home
risks.mitigation: BMS with cell-level protection, fused pack, IEC 62133-2 cells, charging only on the dock
Hardware privacy shutter, on-device processing, GDPR data map
Local autonomy (no cloud in the control loop), offline map

tests.name: Stability on 10° slope and 20 mm threshold
tests.method: Drive over the obstacle course loaded and unloaded

tests.name: Collision force / pinch measurement
tests.method: Force gauge at contact points at max speed

tests.name: Drop from 0.5 m (stairs step) and bump test
tests.method: Free fall on each edge, functional check

tests.name: Battery abuse and charging fault tests

prototype.method: MJF PA12 nylon 3D print (shell) + aluminium profile chassis
steps: Build the drive base on a dev kit + motor driver breakout, tune odometry
Print the shell in MJF PA12, fit the aluminium chassis
Assemble the quick-turn PCBA (power + sensors), BMS on a bought-in pack
Bring up cliff sensors and bump stops before any autonomy
Run the slope / threshold / stairs-edge course
